title: standardize-retry-after-idempotency-for-streaming-and-openai-compat
author: Priya Singh
description: Standardize rate-limit semantics and idempotency behavior across streaming and OpenAI-compat endpoints. This PR unifies Retry-After handling in the API gateway and streaming runtime, improves idempotency key semantics for streaming requests (resume/retry behavior), and harmonizes error codes to match OpenAI compatibility expectations. Motivation: inconsistent Retry-After headers from different internal components caused client-side retry loops and broken resumption behavior for streaming clients. This change ensures a single source of truth for rate-limit headers, maps internal transient errors to consistent OpenAI-style 429/503 responses, and adds robust tests and SDK compatibility shims. Includes docs and changelog entries, and follows the ENG-3124 / ENG-3280 work items.

review_comments: Ethan Brooks (review): Can you ensure Retry-After is always in seconds and present on 429s returned from the gateway? Previously clients saw mixed string durations. Suggested adding a test asserting numeric header.

Priya Singh (reply): Added middleware-level normalization and unit test. Retry-After now set as integer seconds and we include both Retry-After header and a structured JSON retry_after field for compatibility.

Carlos Rivera (review): Streaming resume logic looks good but we need a clear expiration policy for idempotency entries to avoid unbounded storage. Please add eviction TTL and a one-time-use flag for resumed sessions.
Priya Singh (reply): Added TTL configuration (defaults to 24h) and eviction job. Documented the behavior in streaming-resume.md and included tests covering expiration and one-time resume semantics.
Lena Müller (review): e2e streaming tests flaky locally on macos runners; consider making timing tolerances configurable or use test harness time-control. Also please update SDK example.
Priya Singh (reply): Switched e2e to use deterministic timeouts and harness sleep mocks. Updated python SDK example with retry-after parsing helper and resumption snippet. Fixed flaky tests.
Ethan Brooks (approval): Approving after fixes and green CI. Nice to have a follow-up to surface metrics for resumed vs fresh streams.
requested_changes: Add TTL and eviction for idempotency store (addressed)
Normalize Retry-After to numeric seconds and provide structured field (addressed)
Add SDK example for resumption and parsing retry-after (addressed)
release_notes:
Standardized Retry-After semantics for API and streaming endpoints; improved idempotency semantics for streaming requests (TTL + resume behavior); OpenAI compatibility: consistent 429/503 mapping and structured retry_after field; SDK examples updated.
Impact: clients should parse Retry-After as numeric seconds and use the provided resumption flow for streaming retries.
notes: This PR centralizes rate-limit header generation in the API gateway to avoid divergent Retry-After formats from downstream services.
OpenAI-compat translator now emits structured error bodies: {"type": "rate_limit_error", "retry_after": <seconds>}.
Idempotency store uses request fingerprint + session id to allow safe resume for streaming clients while preventing duplicate processing for replays.
Added metrics: api.rate_limit.retried, streaming.resume.success, streaming.resume.expired (follow-up to instrument dashboards).
